description: This XML file defines a set of simple methods for managing facility contact mechanisms within the OFBiz framework, including creating, updating, and deleting various contact mechanisms and their purposes.

methods.name: createFacilityContactMech
methods.description: Creates a new facility contact mechanism, optionally with a purpose, and assigns an ID.

methods.name: updateFacilityContactMech
methods.description: Updates an existing facility contact mechanism and manages related purposes.

methods.name: deleteFacilityContactMech
methods.description: Deletes (or marks as expired) a facility contact mechanism based on parameters.

methods.name: createFacilityPostalAddress
methods.description: Creates a postal address contact mechanism for a facility, including geolocation if provided.

methods.name: updateFacilityPostalAddress
methods.description: Updates the postal address and geolocation information for a facility contact mechanism.

methods.name: createFacilityTelecomNumber
methods.description: Creates a telecom contact number for a facility.

methods.name: updateFacilityTelecomNumber
methods.description: Updates a telecom contact number for a facility.

methods.name: createFacilityEmailAddress
methods.description: Creates an email address contact mechanism for a facility.

methods.name: updateFacilityEmailAddress
methods.description: Updates an email address contact mechanism for a facility.

methods.name: createFacilityContactMechPurpose
methods.description: Creates a purpose for a facility contact mechanism.

methods.name: deleteFacilityContactMechPurpose
methods.description: Deletes (sets thruDate) a purpose for a facility contact mechanism.
